description: Read a task's trail messages (protocol v0.2 trail_messages, GET /tasks/:id/messages): question, answer, handoff and note/discussion entries, last 100, newest last (reading order). Optionally filter to a comma-separated set of kinds. Read tier. Post with tascan_post_message.

kinds.description: Optional comma-separated kind filter, e.g. question,answer,handoff,note (discussion is stored as note; both names are accepted).

name: tascan_get_task_trail
